canonical_objects.acknowledgment: ArtifactAcknowledgment：id/artifact_ref/accepted_subject/accepted_scope/decision_source/conditions；单独保存指定用途的人工决定，不是artifact.accepted布尔。
canonical_objects.execution: 首版专业实际结果是PackagingResult及Task输出；工厂实际结果是RunResult及其RunInputRef。旧逻辑execution_result仅描述后置专业插件的执行记录，不能虚构首版新API对象。

scope_status: 推荐业务词表；W00-C02公共消费者合入前不宣称已有自动推导。

outcome_rule.Fail: 任一所请求硬条件有严格违反即Fail；保留未完成项，不因缺其他检查抹掉反例。
outcome_rule.Undetermined: 无已证Fail但缺输入/覆盖/所需制造内容、精度或预算不足，保持未知。
outcome_rule.Pass: 所有明确所需目的均有可核对通过与必需内容；空checks集合或缺目的不能依空集all()取得Pass。
outcome_rule.input_error: 畸形引用/单位/域问题沿既有InvalidInput；合法几何不满足为专业Fail；取消/未执行不写完整结果。

required_payload_resolution: 按目标工艺精确版本确定要求，不能由请求人省略manufacturing来伪造完整纸包装；结果文件及原始Job可编辑输入分别存在，是否齐备从实际文件/内容校核。
mechanism_evidence: 六份Job只证明构造/Schema；cover分支不是滑套闭缝的实际几何证明。
manufacturing_gate: 每个显式part有cut轮廓；存在折带时有相应fold；存在胶接时从生效双面共同区域产glue。无折/胶结构可明确零需求，不用猜胶；有胶连接但缺区域为Undetermined。面积mm²、显式part数量，不从订单放大。
editable_project: ArtifactRecord.input_ref必须指向实际冻结的可编辑PackageStructureJob及所需材料/依赖；SVG只作制造成果，不能替可编辑结构/过程。

current_consumer_binding_selection.scope: first-release single paper-packaging execution profile per actual consumer; no new wire fields
current_consumer_binding_selection.active_selection: Project.bindings preserves successful explicit adoption order. The last successfully adopted binding for the same exact consumer is its current execution choice; historical rows remain unchanged. This is explicit adoption order, not newest artifact or Job revision.
current_consumer_binding_selection.gate: The current choice must still match the independently selected exact Job, currently selected operation, exact subject, accepted purposes, actual provider, actual frozen files and runtime authority. Changing Job/product alone never grants a new binding; the current choice stays needs-review and blocks until explicitly adopted.
current_consumer_binding_selection.historical: Older bindings/Jobs/artifacts/acknowledgments and old Run snapshots remain readable and unchanged. Superseded bindings do not block the new explicitly adopted current consumer; immutable references/identity integrity still apply to all stored documents.
current_consumer_binding_selection.reselect: Re-adopting a historical artifact is another explicit current selection and creates/appends a new binding fact; only repeating the already-current identical choice may be idempotent. No automatic latest or silent fallback.
current_consumer_binding_selection.consumers: Domain current-use issues and actual Host Run validation must call the same current-binding derivation; save/reopen preserves binding list order. Imported order/labels alone never grant actual producer/UI authority.
